import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, target
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point, project
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from skimage.measure import label, regionprops

obs=current(); ARM="right"
pose=obs.pose(ARM)
j_now=np.array(pose.axis("y").xyz); j_now/=np.linalg.norm(j_now)
CUP_TOP_OFF=0.96514-0.83703; CUP_R=0.06730/2
VASE_MIN=np.array([0.20205965,-0.09837985,0.78877390]); VASE_MAX=np.array([0.30389755,0.00459694,0.90682668])
vx=(VASE_MIN[0]+VASE_MAX[0])/2; vy=(VASE_MIN[1]+VASE_MAX[1])/2; rim_z=VASE_MAX[2]

def build(phi_deg,psi_deg,clear):
    ph=np.radians(phi_deg); ps=np.radians(psi_deg)
    n=np.array([np.sin(ph)*np.cos(ps),np.sin(ph)*np.sin(ps),np.cos(ph)])
    u=np.array([0,0,-1.0])-np.dot([0,0,1.0],n)*n; u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
    M=np.array([vx-CUP_R*u[0], vy-CUP_R*u[1], rim_z+clear])
    l6=M+CUP_TOP_OFF*n
    a=-n; j=j_now-np.dot(j_now,a)*a; j/=np.linalg.norm(j)
    return l6,a,j,M
def q_from(a,j):
    a=np.asarray(a,float); a/=np.linalg.norm(a); j=np.asarray(j,float); j=j-a*np.dot(a,j); j/=np.linalg.norm(j)
    return R.from_matrix(np.column_stack([a,j,np.cross(a,j)])).as_quat()

def dark_blobs(camname, p_world, rad=70, thr=95, min_area=20):
    cam=obs.camera(camname); rgb=np.asarray(cam.rgb)
    puv=project(p_world, camname)
    if not puv.in_frame(): return None, puv.uv
    u=int(round(float(puv.uv[0]))); v=int(round(float(puv.uv[1])))
    u0,u1=max(0,u-rad),min(rgb.shape[1],u+rad); v0,v1=max(0,v-rad),min(rgb.shape[0],v+rad)
    crop=rgb[v0:v1,u0:u1].astype(float)
    bright=crop.max(axis=2)
    lab=label(bright<thr)
    pr=[p for p in regionprops(lab) if p.area>=min_area]
    return {"shape":crop.shape,"n":len(pr),
            "blobs":sorted([(int(p.area), [int(p.centroid[0]+v0),int(p.centroid[1]+u0)], [int(x) for x in crop[int(p.centroid[0]),int(p.centroid[1])]]) for p in pr], reverse=True)[:10]}, puv.uv

# --- BEFORE: balls in cup, viewed by right_wrist
link6=np.array(pose.position.xyz); a_now=np.array(pose.axis("x").xyz)
mouth_cup=Point(link6 + CUP_TOP_OFF*a_now, frame="world")
r_before,uvb=dark_blobs("right_wrist", mouth_cup, rad=60, thr=95)
print("cup mouth px", uvb, "dark blobs before:", json.dumps(r_before))
print("pixel samples:", [( (u,v), np.asarray(obs.camera('right_wrist').rgb)[v,u].tolist()) for (u,v) in [(300,290),(310,300),(330,300),(320,270),(280,300),(360,310)]])

# --- ACT: move to pour pose (mouth 10 cm above vase rim)
l6,a,j,M = build(110,270,0.10)
tgt=target(Point(l6,frame="world"), approach=Direction(a,frame="world"), jaw_line=Direction(j,frame="world"), interaction="free_space")
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM:tgt}, speed="normal")
print("MOVE ok",r.ok,"status",r.status,"failure",r.failure_code,"err_m",r.target_error_m)
print("   summary:", r.summary)
if not r.ok or r.status!="reached":
    from robot import handoff
    handoff("pour move did not reach", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

w1 = tools.wait_ticks(20); print("wait1", w1.status)
w2 = tools.wait_ticks(20); print("wait2", w2.status)

obs2=current()
p2=obs2.pose(ARM)
print("link6 now", np.round(p2.position.xyz,4).tolist(), "approach", np.round(p2.axis("x").xyz,4).tolist())
vase_mouth=Point([vx,vy,rim_z],frame="world")
for cam in ("head","right_wrist","left_wrist"):
    rr,uv=dark_blobs.__wrapped__ if False else (None,None)
for cam in ("head","right_wrist"):
    camobj=obs2.camera(cam)
    rgb=np.asarray(camobj.rgb)
    puv=project(vase_mouth, cam)
    out={"uv":None}
    if puv.in_frame():
        u=int(round(float(puv.uv[0]))); v=int(round(float(puv.uv[1]))); rad=60
        u0,u1=max(0,u-rad),min(rgb.shape[1],u+rad); v0,v1=max(0,v-rad),min(rgb.shape[0],v+rad)
        crop=rgb[v0:v1,u0:u1].astype(float); bright=crop.max(axis=2)
        lab=label(bright<95); pr=[p for p in regionprops(lab) if p.area>=20]
        out={"uv":[u,v],"n":len(pr),"blobs":sorted([(int(p.area),[int(p.centroid[0]+v0),int(p.centroid[1]+u0)]) for p in pr],reverse=True)[:10]}
    print("vase region", cam, json.dumps(out))

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point, project, object_geometry
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from skimage.measure import label, regionprops

obs=current(); ARM="right"
pose=obs.pose(ARM)
link6=np.array(pose.position.xyz)
a_now=np.array(pose.axis("x").xyz); a_now/=np.linalg.norm(a_now)
j_now=np.array(pose.axis("y").xyz); j_now/=np.linalg.norm(j_now)

# --- cup interior check (right_wrist view of the tilted cup mouth)
def dark_stats(camname, p_world, rad=60, thr=70):
    cam=obs.camera(camname); rgb=np.asarray(cam.rgb)
    puv=project(p_world, camname)
    if not puv.in_frame(): return {"in_frame":False,"uv":puv.uv.tolist() if puv.uv is not None else None}
    u=int(round(float(puv.uv[0]))); v=int(round(float(puv.uv[1])))
    u0,u1=max(0,u-rad),min(rgb.shape[1],u+rad); v0,v1=max(0,v-rad),min(rgb.shape[0],v+rad)
    crop=rgb[v0:v1,u0:u1].astype(float); bright=crop.max(axis=2)
    lab=label(bright<thr); pr=sorted([p for p in regionprops(lab) if p.area>=25], key=lambda p:-p.area)
    return {"in_frame":True,"uv":[u,v],"n":len(pr),"areas":[int(p.area) for p in pr[:8]],
            "mean_rgb":[round(float(x),1) for x in crop.reshape(-1,3).mean(0)]}

CUP_TOP_OFF=0.96514-0.83703
mouth_now=Point(link6 + CUP_TOP_OFF*a_now, frame="world")
print("cup interior now:", json.dumps(dark_stats("right_wrist", mouth_now, rad=55, thr=70)))
print("cup interior thr=60:", json.dumps(dark_stats("right_wrist", mouth_now, rad=55, thr=60)))

# --- targets: original cup spot
PLACE_XY = np.array([0.05434, -0.07189])
UP_X, UP_Y = 0.19957, CUP_TOP_OFF    # measured link6->cup bottom and link6->mouth along approach
jaw_up = j_now - np.dot(j_now, np.array([0,0,-1.0]))*np.array([0,0,-1.0]); jaw_up/=np.linalg.norm(jaw_up)
a_up=np.array([0,0,-1.0])
q_up = R.from_matrix(np.column_stack([a_up, jaw_up, np.cross(a_up,jaw_up)])).as_quat()
p_approach = np.array([PLACE_XY[0], PLACE_XY[1], 0.7656+0.001+0.05+UP_X])
p_low      = np.array([PLACE_XY[0], PLACE_XY[1], 0.7656+0.001+UP_X])
print("approach", np.round(p_approach,4), "low", np.round(p_low,4))

def mk(p):
    return target(Point(p,frame="world"), approach=Direction(a_up,frame="world"), jaw_line=Direction(jaw_up,frame="world"), interaction="free_space")

plan = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(p_approach)}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("dry_run return: feasible", getattr(plan,"feasible",None), "failure", getattr(plan,"failure_code",None))
print("  ", plan.summary)
if not getattr(plan,"feasible",False):
    handoff("return move infeasible", summary=plan.summary)

r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(p_approach)}, speed="normal")
print("MOVE ret ok",r.ok,"status",r.status,"failure",r.failure_code,"err",r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok or r.status!="reached":
    handoff("return move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(p_low)}, speed="careful")
print("MOVE low ok",r.ok,"status",r.status,"failure",r.failure_code,"err",r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok or r.status!="reached":
    handoff("place descent failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

g=tools.set_gripper(targets={"right":"open"})
print("OPEN ok",g.ok,"status",g.status,"failure",g.failure_code, g.summary)
r=tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(p_low+np.array([0,0,0.09]))}, speed="normal")
print("MOVE up ok",r.ok,"status",r.status,"failure",r.failure_code,"err",r.target_error_m)

obs2=current()
print("right link6", np.round(obs2.pose(ARM).position.xyz,4).tolist())
# --- measure vase and cup
gv=tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="vase")["result"]
for c in gv["candidates"][:2]:
    loc=c["localization"]
    gg=object_geometry(c)
    print("VASE", c["candidate_id"], "ctr", np.round(loc["center_xyz_m"],4).tolist(),
          "zmax", round(loc["aabb_max_xyz_m"][2],4), "zmin", round(loc["aabb_min_xyz_m"][2],4),
          "height", round(loc["height_above_support_m"],4), "axes", np.round(np.array(gg.principal_axes_world),2).tolist())
gc=tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="yellow cup")["result"]
for c in gc["candidates"][:2]:
    loc=c["localization"]; gg=object_geometry(c)
    print("CUP", c["candidate_id"], "ctr", np.round(loc["center_xyz_m"],4).tolist(),
          "height", round(loc["height_above_support_m"],4), "support", round(loc["support_z_m"],4),
          "extent", np.round(loc["extent_xyz_m"],4).tolist(),
          "largest_axis", np.round(np.array(gg.largest_extent_axis_world),3).tolist())

from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, project, Point
from skimage.measure import label, regionprops

obs=current()
plan=tools.return_home(arms=["right"], dry_run=True)
print("home dry_run feasible", getattr(plan,"feasible",None), getattr(plan,"failure_code",None), plan.summary)
if not getattr(plan,"feasible",False):
    handoff("return_home infeasible", summary=plan.summary)
r=tools.return_home(arms=["right"])
print("HOME ok",r.ok,"status",r.status,"failure",r.failure_code)
obs=current()
print("right link6", np.round(obs.pose("right").position.xyz,4).tolist())

def report(camname):
    cam=obs.camera(camname); rgb=np.asarray(cam.rgb).astype(float)
    bright=rgb.max(axis=2)
    lab=label(bright<70); pr=[p for p in regionprops(lab) if 25<=p.area<=2000]
    print(f"dark blobs {camname}:")
    for p in sorted(pr,key=lambda p:-p.area)[:10]:
        cy,cx=p.centroid
        print("   area",int(p.area),"uv",[int(cx),int(cy)],"bbox",[int(x) for x in p.bbox])
    return pr
report("head")
report("left_wrist")
report("right_wrist")

          "h", round(loc["height_above_support_m"],4), "ext", np.round(loc["extent_xyz_m"],4).tolist(),
